title: SDLC Delivery Any Reference v1
description: A bare work-item ID, bare task UID, task-local, work-item-local, task-qualified, or globally qualified SDLC reference used by the delivery contract. It follows the shared SDLC reference shape while remaining file-addressable for offline delivery-schema validation.
$comment: The canonical shared reference contract remains https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/any-reference/v1. This file is the delivery contract's file-addressable common type so schema-validate can resolve the same reference grammar without network access. Host validation must resolve the selected scope and entity.
